nodes.name: Customer portal

nodes.name: Checkout API
nodes.description: Coordinates fraud decisions, stock reservation and payment authorisation.
nodes.purpose: Make purchase steps explicit and preserve their ordering.

nodes.name: Fraud decision service
nodes.description: Approves or rejects checkout attempts using velocity and device signals.
nodes.purpose: Reduce chargebacks before funds are authorised.

nodes.name: Velocity rules
nodes.description: Rejects excessive purchase attempts within a rolling window.
nodes.purpose: Block repeated purchase attempts before payment authorisation.

nodes.name: VelocityRule
nodes.description: Wraps attempt counting and shared configuration access.
nodes.purpose: Keep the rolling-window rule behind one contract.

nodes.name: evaluate()
nodes.description: Reads the legacy bypass flag before comparing recent attempts with the limit.
nodes.purpose: Return an explicit allow or deny decision for one checkout.

nodes.name: Legacy configuration
nodes.description: Defines the legacy velocity bypass flag and attempt threshold.
nodes.purpose: Preserve a partner exception that is only explained in a team note.

nodes.name: Payments API
nodes.description: Routes authorisation requests and writes ledger entries.
nodes.purpose: Keep payment execution separate from checkout orchestration.

nodes.name: Legacy Payment Adapter
nodes.description: A source fragment forwards requests to a legacy gateway; behaviour beyond that is unverified.
nodes.purpose: Unknown.

nodes.name: Payment router
nodes.description: Selects the payment gateway for an order.
nodes.purpose: Isolate routing policies from gateway implementations.

nodes.name: Payment ledger
nodes.description: Stores a synthetic authorisation journal for reconciliation.
nodes.purpose: Explain which payment attempt produced each ledger entry.

nodes.name: Inventory API
nodes.description: Checks and reserves available stock before payment.
nodes.purpose: Avoid authorising purchases for unavailable items.

nodes.name: Stock reservation
nodes.description: Places a short-lived hold on an order's items.
nodes.purpose: Prevent two checkouts from claiming the same stock.

nodes.name: Stock events
nodes.description: Publishes changes in available inventory.
nodes.purpose: Keep downstream product views up to date.

nodes.name: Warehouse store
nodes.description: Represents the authoritative stock record.
nodes.purpose: Provide a single inventory count for reservation checks.

nodes.name: Risk analytics
nodes.description: Summarises synthetic fraud decisions across purchase sessions.
nodes.purpose: Help investigators compare suspicious activity.

nodes.name: Device signals
nodes.description: Maps synthetic device identifiers to risk signals.
nodes.purpose: Add a second signal beyond purchase velocity.

nodes.name: Customer profile
nodes.description: Supplies synthetic account-age and previous-decision features.
nodes.purpose: Give fraud rules context about the purchasing account.

nodes.name: Recommendation API
nodes.description: Returns a ranked set of products for the storefront.
nodes.purpose: Help visitors discover items without blocking checkout.

nodes.name: Product ranking
nodes.description: Orders candidate products using fixed demonstration features.
nodes.purpose: Make recommendation ordering explainable.

nodes.name: Product cache
nodes.description: Keeps synthetic product metadata close to the ranking code.
nodes.purpose: Avoid repeated catalogue lookups during browsing.

nodes.name: Storefront UI
nodes.description: Presents the customer cart, recommendations and checkout result.
nodes.purpose: Offer one consistent customer-facing purchase flow.

nodes.name: Shopping cart
nodes.description: Collects line items before a checkout request.
nodes.purpose: Keep the customer's purchase intent together.

nodes.name: Customer session
nodes.description: Represents a fictional browser session without real customer data.
nodes.purpose: Connect customer interactions within the synthetic journey.

nodes.name: Shared platform config
nodes.description: Distributes common settings to Checkout and Fraud.
nodes.purpose: Keep cross-service feature settings in a shared contract.

nodes.name: Order events
nodes.description: Publishes purchase outcomes for downstream consumers.
nodes.purpose: Decouple post-purchase work from the checkout response.

nodes.name: API contracts
nodes.description: Purchase request and response contracts; structural grouping.

nodes.description: Representative rule tests; see the Evidence inspector.
